fact: Mozambique's Ministry of Education presented its EMIS (StatEduc), updated in 2021 and 2022, as fed by censuses covering primary, secondary, adult education and school mapping.
The Ministry's Head of Statistics said Mozambique plans a fully digital platform for real-time entry, piloting tools like DHIS2 for offline dashboards.

The education ministry's Planning and Cooperation Directorate runs the annual 3 March school census (Levantamento Escolar 2024, public and private schools) and its Statistics Department publishes the resulting education statistics brochure each year.

A GPE KIX-supported assessment on 3-4 August 2026 found Mozambique has an established EMIS with multiple education data subsystems, electronic data platforms and processes for validating and disseminating education statistics, and that education statistics already inform teacher deployment and resource allocation.
